scope_note: All 44 completed-bundle-4 records, expectations/rubrics and exact supplied passages were read. This artifact contains provisional source-aware agent analysis, not human answer reviews, independent reference labels or official benchmark truth. No active bundle was inspected and no model inference was requested.
assessment_policy: Separate the factual answer from support in actual context and relevance/version compatibility of its citations. A correct gold match or compatible citation is not sufficient by itself; unresolved citation-to-claim alignment remains needs_human_review. Run errors remain ungraded errors.

findings: All four context answers substitute a ContextVar/model-constructor workaround for ValidationInfo.context on validation methods; the primary context-access evidence was not retrieved.

Three return-validation answers invent a return parameter. Basic/after names validate_return correctly, but neither supplied passage supports the return-validation facts, so it is not proposed as grounded.
Basic/after and filtered/before model-before answers contradict themselves by saying Yes to always-dictionary safety while admitting arbitrary input objects.
Filtered/before field-deprecation output gives the correct core effects but adds an unsupported restriction to string/boolean deprecation forms.

All four async answers are factually correct and have relevant context, but cite a parameter-signature chunk rather than the explicit async-support chunk. Their citation-to-claim alignment remains unresolved.
The two filtered/after field-deprecation and adapter-annotation requests timed out. Both records remain run_error, not semantic failures or omitted observations.
No cited-ID membership or explicit 2.10.6 compatibility mismatch was found in the 42 structured answers. That mechanical observation does not imply semantic correctness or relevant citation support.

The 27 proposed passes include supported sorting exceptions, two deprecation responses, three adapter-annotation responses, model-after return values, two unambiguous before-input responses, overrides, unannotated Any defaults and supported function signatures. These are AI-assisted proposals, not an accuracy estimate.
